references.methodology: Previously captured tools/list inventory persisted in docs/github-tool-parity.json and mapped one-for-one for parity analysis.
references.caveats: This is a pinned historical remote-plugin capture, not the current GitHub MCP local default surface. It is informational and must never gate GitLab MCP CI.

references.methodology: Official README documents the default toolsets as context, repos, issues, pull_requests, and users.
references.caveats: Tool membership changes over time, so a toolset count is not equivalent to a visible-tool count or schema-byte measurement. Recorded only as a design prior.

references.methodology: Public README reports the default Free/CE dynamic surface as gitlab_find_action plus gitlab_execute_action with 851 reachable actions and 2,192 tool-schema tokens measured with the cl100k_base tokenizer.
references.caveats: A two-meta-tool dynamic dispatcher is architecturally different from this project's typed static tools, and its cl100k_base token count is not directly comparable to this project's utf8-bytes-div-4 estimate. The values are informational context-cost priors only and are not target thresholds.

references.methodology: Public README describes the server as exposing 86 typed GitLab MCP tools.
references.caveats: Published tool count is not independently re-derived here and includes a different feature/API scope. It is informational only and must never gate GitLab MCP CI.
